自然接话：按点名和角色卡的健谈程度选人，每位入选成员本轮回复一次；无人入选时随机: Natural: select mentioned members and use character-card talkativeness. Each selected member replies once. If nobody is selected, pick one randomly; 0% is not mute.
列表顺序：所有在场且未静音的成员按列表依次回复，不受健谈程度影响。: List order: all present, unmuted members reply in order, regardless of talkativeness.
手动点名：仅输入 @ 并选择的成员回复，不受健谈程度影响；未点名时不会自动选人。: Manual: only members selected with @ reply, regardless of talkativeness. No mention means no automatic selection.
轮换池：每轮从在场且未静音的成员中按顺序选一位，不受健谈程度影响。: Rotation: one present, unmuted member replies per round in turn, regardless of talkativeness.
由玩家设定，适用于所有群聊的自然接话；其他发言方式不受影响。0% 不等于静音，若: Set by the player for natural mode in every group. Other modes are unaffected. At 0%, the character can still be picked by the fallback when no one is selected.
本轮名单按发言方式确定；后续回复仍需点击继续，不自动覆盖当前台词。: The speaking mode determines this round’s speakers. Click Continue for subsequent replies; the current line stays until then.
健谈程度在管理角色的角色卡中设置，适用于所有群聊。: Set talkativeness in Manage characters. The character setting applies to every group.
健谈程度已移至角色卡，请到管理角色修改: Talkativeness is now part of the character card. Change it in Manage characters.
请先完成或停止当前轮次，再修改发言方式: Finish or stop the current round before changing the speaking mode.
请先输入 @ 并选择至少一位在场且未静音的成员。: Type @ and select at least one present, unmuted member.
当前没有可发言的成员，请先加入成员或取消静音。: No members can speak. Add a member or unmute someone.

仅显示当前身份与角色有权知道的来源；共享人格不会开放其他身份的私聊。: Only sources visible to the current persona and character are shown. A shared personality does not reveal other personas' private chats.
来源未载入此页，原始记录仍保留。: This source is not loaded on this page. The original record is retained.
此范围还没有记录。: No records in this scope yet.
记忆只读。请在聊天中说明更正，或说“以后不要主动提起”；原文仍保留。: Memories are read-only. Explain corrections in chat, or ask not to bring a topic up. Original records are retained.
日终整理以已呈现的原文为依据；无新内容可以没有变化。: Daily consolidation uses presented original records. No new content can mean no changes.
当前人生保存有临时上下文压缩记录；它不替代原始历史，也不直接改变人格。: This life has temporary context compression records. They do not replace original history or directly change personality.
会先完整保存当前人生，再恢复所选存档。其他角色与账号用量不会回退。: The current life will be fully archived before the selected snapshot is restored. Other characters and account usage stay unchanged.
会先归档并验证当前人生，再开始新的关系、经验和内容进度；旧人生退出当前聊天上下文: The current life will be archived and verified first. A new life starts with initial relations, experience and content progress; the old life leaves the active chat context.
初始设定只作为起点。此后人设由真实经历缓慢成长，不能再直接编辑；修改模式需先归档: The current card is a starting point. Personality then develops gradually from real experiences and cannot be edited directly. Changing mode requires archiving and resetting.
白板起步保留外观和连接，不继承旧人格与共同往事；启用前先归档当前人生。: A blank start preserves appearance and connections, but does not inherit old personality or shared experiences. The current life is archived first.
输入角色名称确认: Type the character name to confirm
同一角色、同一人生共用人格；各身份关系分别保留，私人记忆不会写入共享人设。: Personality is shared across personas for this character and life. Relations remain separate, and private memories are not written into the shared personality.
以当前设定启用自成长: Enable growth from the current card
成长人设只读。外观、模型连接和健谈程度仍可在管理角色中修改。重新填写人设请使用人: Growth cards are read-only. Appearance, model connection and talkativeness remain editable under Manage characters. To rewrite the card, reset through Life archives.
只展示可公开的变化说明。没有有效经历时可以无变化，重复回忆不算新证据。: Only safe public explanations are shown. Without meaningful experiences there may be no change; recalling an event again is not new evidence.
仍在观察，尚未改变人格。: Still under observation; personality has not changed.
预览不激活此人生，也不会将旧记忆注入当前聊天。: Previewing does not activate this life or inject its old memories into current chat.

新人生已开始；上一人生已归档。: New life started. The previous life was archived.
每份存档成套保存卡片、记忆、各身份关系与进度。数量不限，不自动过期。: Each archive saves the card, memories, each persona's relations and progress together. There is no archive count limit or automatic expiry.
存档已验证并作为独立条目导入；当前人生未改变。: Archive verified and imported as a separate entry. The current life is unchanged.

先保存并验证当前人生，成功后才开始新人生。恢复与重置不会回退其他角色或账号用量。: The current life is saved and verified before a new one starts. Restoring or resetting does not roll back other characters or account usage.
已生成并验证导出文件；请在下载目录保存。: Export file generated and verified. Save it in your downloads folder.
名称与备注已保存，人生事实未改变。: Name and notes saved; life facts are unchanged.
成长人设只读；通过聊天沟通纠正。外观、模型连接和健谈程度仍可修改，重新填写人设请: Growth cards are read-only; discuss corrections in chat. Appearance, model connection and talkativeness remain editable. Archive and reset before rewriting the card.
